value: OriginalFactoryOnly20260409 withactual16MiBFlash/2MiBPSRAM stopsafter35guestms:StoreProhibited EXCVADDR3DFFFFF4, thenSwReset; noLCDframe orTFtraffic. Capacity is notinflated to8MiB tohidefailure.

Independent LX7 instruction tests and physical-pin board-model tests verify SPI window, mode 0/3, full-duplex MOSI/read FF, backlight/reset and distinct SPI card routing. These simulator tests do not prove original full-application or physical-hardware acceptance.
RetainedLCD_Driver sample usesMADCTL70 with135x240,+52/+40bounds while08_SD_LCD selectslandscape TFTrotation1. Bothsourceconfigurations remainrecorded; nooriginalfirmwareisrewritten.

CurrentS3docsreuse a dimensionimage namedC6-GEEK; sourcefilename conflict isexplicit. ExactS3rearphotos andelectricalpins are retained, notC6electronics. Casewall/cap/USBdepths andsidecutoutpositions remainestimated/unknown.

limitations: This model is a dimension/photo reconstruction, not manufacturer CAD.
Unmeasured depths, corner radii and connector contact geometry are explicit illustrative estimates; no fit, drop-in enclosure or hardware acceptance claim.
Source photographs are unchanged. Any display artwork shown in them is reference only; the live screen receives the simulator framebuffer.

CurrentofficialS3documentation reuses a dimensionimage namedESP32-C6-GEEK; theimage is retained verbatim and thecross-familyfilename conflict is explicit. No C6electricalpins, memory or internalassembly are substituted.

Outer61×24.5×9mm includes16mm removableUSBcap; separatehollowcap/body and live opticalopening reconstructed. Cap/USBfit, wallthickness, sideconnectoropenings, rearlabels, keytravel and internalclearances remain unknown. BOOT0 workbenchcontrol has no invented3Dtarget.
S3rearphoto shows threeMX1.25connectors andSDsocket; their exactbodycutout coordinates are not calibrated. Originalimages remain available; no idealizedcomponentassembly is claimed.
